I have reviewed the implementation of Phase 3, Chunk 2. **Evidence:** 1. **Scope:** ``` $ git diff HEAD --stat app.py | 6 ++++++ 1 file changed, 6 insertions(+) ``` The scope matches perfectly. Only `app.py` was modified, and `api/profile.py` / `templates/profile.html` were created. No model changes or modifications to existing tests were found. 2. **Auth Guard & Fail-closed on None:** ```python $ cat api/profile.py def handle_profile(): if "user_id" not in session: return redirect(url_for("login")) profile = get_user_profile(session["user_id"]) if profile is None: return redirect(url_for("login")) return render_template("profile.html", profile=profile) ``` The handler correctly implements the auth guard, ensures DB is the source of truth, takes no `?id=` parameters, and redirects to login if the user profile returns `None`. 3. **Template Contract:** ```html $ cat templates/profile.html ...
Username: {{ profile.username }}
Email: {{ profile.email }}
Full Name: {{ profile.full_name }}
Address: {{ profile.address }}
... ``` The template is a standalone file (no `{% extends %}`), reuses `banking.css`, and restricts itself explicitly to the four requested contract keys. 4. **No Nav Link:** ``` $ grep -rn '/profile' templates/ [Exit code 1 - No matches found] ``` Confirmed no navigation link was added to any existing pages. 5. **Test Quality & Regression:** ``` $ .venv/bin/pytest test/test_profile_route.py -v 6 passed in 0.11s $ .venv/bin/pytest -q 96 passed in 0.25s ``` The provided locked test covers all spec scenarios perfectly, and all 96 existing regression tests pass successfully. ACCEPT
